categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in terrestrial TV broadcasting, radio broadcasting, and advertising. It also engages in content production, distribution, and cultural services such as exhibitions and performances. Subsidiaries focus on content planning, investment, production, distribution, and drama production leveraging intellectual property rights.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced broadcasting technologies including UHD terrestrial broadcasting and digital media platforms. It develops proprietary systems such as content lifecycle analysis, AI-based clip classification, and video codec optimization for FAST channels. Production relies heavily on human resources like directors, writers, and actors, with a mix of in-house and outsourced content creation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic and international media platforms such as OTT services, IPTV, cable TV, satellite broadcasters, and online platforms. The company serves advertisers through TV and radio advertising sales and supplies content to global broadcasters and digital platforms, focusing on markets in Japan, China, Taiwan, and Southeast Asia.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in South Korea with headquarters and production centers in Seoul and Gyeonggi Province. Content distribution extends internationally to Asia-Pacific regions including Japan, China, Taiwan, and Southeast Asia through partnerships and direct sales to media companies.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily midstream and downstream in the media supply chain, producing and distributing broadcast content and selling advertising slots. It controls content creation, broadcasting platforms, and content distribution channels, including digital and OTT platforms.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include strengthening content competitiveness, expanding multi-studio production systems, and integrating production and distribution functions. R&D focuses on AI technologies for content classification, automated metadata generation, video codec efficiency, and interactive media services. The company also pursues joint government-supported research projects on media technology and copyright protection.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly from broadcasting advertising sales (TV and radio), content sales and licensing to domestic and international platforms, and related cultural and advertising services. The company also earns from sponsorships, intellectual property exploitation, and digital media services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the three major terrestrial broadcasters in South Korea, competing with KBS and MBC. It holds a leading market share in terrestrial TV advertising (~31.5% in 2023) and is recognized for strong content competitiveness. Competition is intensifying due to growth of cable, satellite, IPTV, and OTT platforms.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 997 billion KRW in 2023, a 15.1% decrease from the previous year, with operating profit of 58.3 billion KRW. Despite market contraction, it maintains profitability and a strong capital base with total assets of 1.35 trillion KRW and equity of 881 billion KRW. The company is focused on sustainable growth through content and operational efficiency.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its exclusive access to high-quality terrestrial broadcast content with proven audience ratings, enabling strong advertising sales. It leverages advanced technology and creative talent to produce differentiated content and offers multi-platform distribution capabilities. Its integrated production and distribution model and strong brand recognition provide competitive advantages in a converging media environment.
